message.content: Let me add a debug print to fuzz_open_socket to see if it's being called. Let me rebuild the callback object and relink.

function.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/curl_fuzzer && sed -i 's|  (void)purpose;\\n  (void)address;|  (void)purpose;\\n  (void)address;\\n  fprintf(stderr, \"DEBUG: fuzz_open_socket called, purpose=%d\\\\n\", purpose);|' curl_fuzzer_callback.cc && grep -n \"DEBUG: fuzz_open_socket\" curl_fuzzer_callback.cc"}
function.name: execute_bash
